findings: Irodori confirma una forma negativa cortés じゃないです y señala では para escritura.
Irodori, Grammar notes, PDF p. 18 (Lesson 7 section ➎) gives ナA-じゃないです and alternative ナA-じゃありません, with アパートはあまり静かじゃないです. The same passage contrasts it with イA-くないです.
limitations: La entrada formula la negación simple ではない; el recurso consultado no explica directamente esa forma simple ni todos los contrastes de estilo.
Polite forms are supported, but plain ではない and the article’s register claims are not documented there; coverage remains partial.
No canonical Evidence was created and assessEntry did not pass; article unchanged and status not promoted to VERIFIED.
